about: Sourced meanings for the fields and code values the claim explainer most often meets. Built 2026-09-29 to fix a measured gap: 26 to 28 of every 30 saved answers said some version of 'I can't say what this means' because data/data_dictionary.md covers few fields and no code values. Every entry names its source. Entries that could not be verified are left out on purpose, so the agent still says it cannot describe them. See docs/PHASE4.md, section 'Adding sourced definitions'.
synthetic_note: The claims are CMS synthetic data. A code on a claim here does not describe a real patient, diagnosis or service. Use these meanings to say what a code or field IS, never to tell a story about the patient.
selection_rule: HCPCS codes seen 3 or more times, and diagnosis codes seen 4 or more times, in the 600-row validation sample (data/processed/val_sample_v2.parquet): 26 HCPCS codes covering 73.7% of rows and 24 diagnosis codes covering 83.7% of rows. All 9 place-of-service values seen in the sample are covered. Chosen by frequency, before looking at any answer text from the held-out evaluation claims.

not_verified_left_out.reason: The first lookups for HCPCS A4604, G9572, M1069, H2001 and ICD-10 C50.929, M54.50 were refused with a rate-limit error (HTTP 429) and the proxy said not to refetch those exact pages. All six were later verified through different query pages of the same NLM service, so they are now in the reference. CPT 99401 is left out because no CMS document found in this session describes it (CMS Transmittal 12546 was checked and does not mention it; 99397 appears there and is in the cpt section); every other CPT code in the sample is in the cpt section with its CMS source.

hcpcs_level_ii.name: HCPCS Level II long descriptions, via the U.S. National Library of Medicine Clinical Table Search Service (the code set is maintained by CMS)

icd10cm.name: ICD-10-CM code titles, via the U.S. National Library of Medicine Clinical Table Search Service (the code set is maintained by CMS and NCHS)

place_of_service.name: CMS Place of Service Code Set

resdac.name: ResDAC (Research Data Assistance Center) variable documentation for CMS claims files

cpt_note: A 5-digit numeric HCPCS_CD value is a CPT code (HCPCS Level I). CPT is maintained and licensed by the American Medical Association, which owns the official descriptors, so this project does not carry them. Entries in the cpt section are our own short paraphrases of what a CMS document says about the code, each with that document as its source; they are not the official AMA wording. A CPT code that is not in the cpt section has no CMS source on file: the agent may say it is a CPT code and that no description is carried here, and may not describe what the procedure is.
not_applicable_note: The value NOT_APPLICABLE is a placeholder this project's pipeline writes when a field does not exist for that claim type (see data/FEATURE_ENGINEERING.md, sentinel fill of claim-type-exclusive fields). It means the field does not apply to this claim's file, not that a value is missing or wrong.

LINE_PLACE_OF_SRVC_CD.meaning: Place of service code for this claim line: where the service was delivered, using the Medicare place-of-service code set. Exists on carrier and durable medical equipment (DME) claims, not on outpatient facility claims.

TAX_NUM.meaning: The federal taxpayer identification number (TIN) of the physician, practice or supplier paid for the line-item service. Exists on carrier and DME claims. The values in this synthetic data are not real TINs.

CARR_CLM_BLG_NPI_NUM.meaning: The National Provider Identifier (NPI) of the billing provider on a carrier claim. The values in this synthetic data are not real NPIs.

ORG_NPI_NUM.meaning: The National Provider Identifier (NPI) of the organization or group practice on the claim. Exists on institutional files (such as outpatient) and carrier claims. The values in this synthetic data are not real NPIs.

LINE_NUM.meaning: The line number of a service on a claim: a sequence number that separates the distinct services billed on the same claim. ResDAC now names this field CLM_LINE_NUM; this dataset calls it LINE_NUM.

CARR_LINE_PRCNG_LCLTY_CD.meaning: Pricing locality code: a carrier-specific geographic identifier used to price line items on carrier claims. Medicare fee-for-service pricing uses 89 localities across states.

LINE_PRMRY_ALOWD_CHRG_AMT.meaning: The allowed charge amount from a primary payer other than Medicare for this line-item service, filled in only when such an amount exists. Exists on DME claims.

REV_CNTR_TOT_CHRG_AMT.meaning: Total charges, covered and non-covered, for all accommodations and services in the billing period, before deductible and coinsurance reductions. Exists on institutional files such as outpatient.

ICD_DGNS_CD<n>.meaning: One of the numbered diagnosis code fields on a claim (ICD_DGNS_CD1, ICD_DGNS_CD2, and so on). Each holds one ICD-10-CM diagnosis code that identifies a diagnosis for the beneficiary.

99241.meaning: A consultation service code, one of the office or outpatient consultation codes 99241 to 99245. Medicare stopped recognizing consultation codes for payment on January 1, 2010.

90935.meaning: A renal dialysis procedure code for physician dialysis services. CMS says evaluation and management services related to the dialysis procedure are included in it.
90935.source: https://www.cms.gov/files/document/11-chapter11-ncci-medicare-policy-manual-2025finalcleanpdf.pdf (NCCI Medicare Policy Manual, chapter 11); also listed in Medicare Claims Processing Manual chapter 8, section 170, physician dialysis services (https://www.cms.gov/regulations-and-guidance/guidance/manuals/downloads/clm104c08.pdf)

99408.meaning: A structured alcohol and/or substance (other than tobacco) abuse assessment with a brief intervention. CMS describes 99408 and 99409 as similar to HCPCS G0396 and G0397, and G0396 is a 15 to 30 minute assessment and brief intervention using tools such as AUDIT or DAST.
99408.source: https://www.cms.gov/files/document/12-chapter12-ncci-medicare-policy-manual-2026-final.pdf (NCCI Medicare Policy Manual, chapter 12) and https://www.cms.gov/outreach-and-education/medicare-learning-network-mln/mlnproducts/downloads/sbirt_factsheet_icn904084.pdf (for G0396)

96156.meaning: A health behavior assessment or re-assessment: it identifies the psychological, behavioral, emotional, cognitive and social factors that affect a physical health problem and its treatment.

99495.meaning: Transitional care management after a hospital or facility discharge: interactive contact within 2 business days of discharge, a face-to-face visit within 14 calendar days, and at least moderate complexity medical decision making.

96127.meaning: A developmental and behavioral screening and testing code. CMS Local Coverage Article A57481 lists it with 96110, 96112 and 96113 for developmental or behavioral screening and testing.

45378.meaning: A colonoscopy code. CMS notes it must not be used for an examination limited to the anus.

99397.meaning: A comprehensive preventive medicine evaluation and management code (CMS refers to the range 99381 to 99397). CMS says these codes should not be used for Medicare annual wellness visits and that preventive medicine services under them are noncovered by Medicare; HCPCS G codes are used for the wellness visits instead.
